responsibility: Implements `TyCtxt`’s HIR map interface for navigating and querying the local crate HIR. This file exposes stable accessors from `HirId`/`LocalDefId` to owner nodes, parent relationships, spans, attributes, paths, and item metadata, and provides the traversals and collectors that derive crate- and module-level `ModuleItems` from HIR structure.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `hir/mod.rs`, which owns shared HIR-side container types and provider registration, this `mod.rs` is the concrete local-HIR map implementation: indexing owners, mapping `HirId`/`LocalDefId` to nodes, parents, spans, bodies, and running the HIR collection pass that builds that index.
